categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Favored Nanotechnology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, and production of high-performance, multifunctional nano thin films and nano coating equipment. The company provides nano thin film products and coating services tailored to various industries including consumer electronics, automotive, medical devices, servers, and smart home products. It also manufactures and sells vacuum nano coating equipment based on proprietary technology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD), chemical vapor deposition (CVD), physical vapor deposition (PVD), atomic layer deposition (ALD), and other vacuum nano coating technologies. It integrates polymer material science, low-temperature plasma technology, nano vapor deposition, and automated control to produce dense, multifunctional nano films with properties such as waterproofing, corrosion resistance, electrical insulation, and wear resistance. The company also develops proprietary nano coating equipment with features like multi-layer coating and precise process control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global technology companies in consumer electronics (smartphones, TWS earphones, wearable devices), automotive electronics (new energy vehicles, sensors, motor components), medical devices (hearing aids, medical instruments), servers and data centers, and smart home appliances. The company serves OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers requiring advanced nano coating solutions for product protection and performance enhancement.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Wuxi and subsidiaries in Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Wuhan. It also has wholly-owned subsidiaries in Hong Kong, the United States, and Vietnam, supporting global market expansion. Its sales network covers North America, Europe, the Middle East, and emerging markets including India, Malaysia, Pakistan, and Turkey.
categories.supply_chain_position: Favored Nanotechnology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of nano coating materials, nano thin film products, and coating equipment. It provides coating services directly to downstream manufacturers and supplies equipment to upstream and midstream partners, enabling integrated nano coating solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in nano coating technologies, focusing on transparent hardening, high-voltage insulation, multifunctional composite films, and environmentally friendly materials compliant with global regulations. It invests heavily in R&D (18.73% of revenue in 2024), collaborates with academic institutions, and integrates AI technologies to develop intelligent manufacturing and digital management platforms. Strategic expansion targets include automotive electronics, medical devices, servers, and smart home sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of nano thin film products and related coating services, as well as the sale of proprietary nano coating equipment. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by limited distribution. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Favored Nanotechnology is positioned as a global leader in nano coating technology with strong competitive advantages in proprietary equipment, materials, and process technologies. It has broken foreign monopolies in the nano coating industry and maintains a high market share in consumer electronics and emerging sectors. The company faces competition from traditional protective coating providers and new entrants but leverages its technological barriers, intellectual property portfolio, and customized services to sustain leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 479.46 million, a 55.21% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 45.11 million. Total assets stood at RMB 2.03 billion with a slight decrease due to share repurchases. The company has shown strong growth driven by market recovery and diversified applications, supported by substantial R&D investment and expanding global footprint.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Favored Nanotechnology offers highly customized, multifunctional nano thin films with superior protective properties such as waterproofing, corrosion resistance, electrical insulation, and wear resistance, tailored to complex application environments. Its proprietary vacuum coating equipment and integrated solutions enable high-quality, efficient production. The company emphasizes environmentally friendly materials compliant with stringent international regulations, strong intellectual property protection, and close collaboration with leading customers to deliver innovative, reliable, and cost-effective nano coating solutions.
